capabilities.task_family: Maintain build, deployment, packaging, and release diagnostics for the AI gateway.
trigger_examples: release workflow does not embed frontend dist
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Build artifacts flow from frontend dist generation into Go embed and then container, CI, or Electron package startup.
proof: Frontend build/typecheck baseline when packaging frontend assets
evidence: Current `main.go` embeds both default and classic dist paths; card evidence records full-suite baseline failure when dist files are absent.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Build/release/diagnostics cross the runtime boundary and need different checks from provider relay or frontend feature work.
capabilities.current_state: Covered at fixed revision with L1 routing guidance and baseline test evidence.

capabilities.task_family: Maintain provider adapters and request/response conversion for the unified relay API.
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Client request becomes RelayInfo, channel selection, provider conversion, upstream dispatch, downstream response, quota settlement, and retry/refund on failure.
evidence: History scan counted 733 relay-provider-adapters commits; targeted Go test evidence passed relay/channel and related packages.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Provider conversion is broad but shares the same adapter contracts and relay state machine; task-specific async adapters split into their own lifecycle skill.
capabilities.current_state: Covered at fixed revision with L1 routing guidance and targeted package test evidence.

capabilities.task_family: Maintain the default React admin frontend and user-facing dashboard workflows.
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: TanStack Router pages coordinate feature modules, API clients, stores, Base UI/Tailwind components, and i18next locale keys.
proof: Bun typecheck/build where local dependencies allow
evidence: History scan counted 601 frontend-default commits; card evidence records current web/default typecheck baseline failure from missing tooling/types.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Default frontend owns product UI work; classic commit parity, translations, and shadcn-specific composition remain separate focused skills.
capabilities.current_state: Covered at fixed revision with L1 routing guidance and baseline typecheck evidence.

capabilities.task_family: Apply project-aware shadcn/ui component composition inside the default frontend.
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Component work resolves project aliases and Base UI/Tailwind constraints before generating markup.
proof: Bun typecheck/build when component code changes
evidence: Existing repo-local shadcn skill vendors upstream shadcn rules and project context.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: This remains separate from generic frontend work because registry and component composition have their own external rules.
capabilities.current_state: Covered at fixed revision with L1 routing guidance.

capabilities.task_family: Maintain async task relay submit, remix, poll, conversion, billing adjustment, and refund flows.
trigger_examples: Convert task result to OpenAI video
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Task requests validate action, resolve origin task, estimate billing, pre-consume, submit upstream, persist task data, poll terminal state, and adjust/refund quota.
evidence: History scan counted 178 async-task-relay commits; targeted Go test evidence passed service package including task billing tests.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Async tasks share provider-adapter mechanics but have independent lifecycle and billing transitions that justify a separate skill.
capabilities.current_state: Covered at fixed revision with L1 routing guidance and targeted service test evidence.

capabilities.task_family: Maintain model pricing, tiered expressions, quota conversion, pre-consume, and settlement behavior.
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Pricing settings resolve model/group ratio and optional expression snapshots before pre-consume; settlement recomputes or adjusts quota from usage and stored billing context.
evidence: History scan counted 303 billing-pricing commits; targeted Go test evidence passed pkg/billingexpr and service packages.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Billing expression and quota accounting have shared monetary invariants and must be kept together instead of split by controller/service file.
capabilities.current_state: Covered at fixed revision with L1 routing guidance and targeted package test evidence.

capabilities.task_family: Maintain channel selection, retry, affinity, update/test tasks, and rate-limit coordination.
trigger_examples: Provider retry should skip disabled channels
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Authenticated requests flow through rate limits and channel selection using group/model filters, affinity state, retry state, and channel health data.
evidence: Current code contains distributor middleware, channel affinity service tests, and channel test/update controllers.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Concurrency concerns are a focused loop within relay ownership because they directly determine provider dispatch before adapter conversion.
capabilities.current_state: Covered at fixed revision with L1 routing guidance and targeted package test evidence.

capabilities.task_family: Maintain identity, authentication, SSRF, webhook, passkey, and payment callback trust boundaries.
trigger_examples: Token auth should reject a route
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Requests are authenticated through session or token context, step-up verification can bind Passkey state, outbound URLs are validated before fetch/proxy, and payment orders are bound to providers.
evidence: History scan counted 200 identity-security commits; targeted Go test evidence passed middleware and model packages.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Security-sensitive trust boundaries should remain together because fixes often span middleware, controller, model, and service layers.
capabilities.current_state: Covered at fixed revision with L1 routing guidance and targeted package test evidence.

capabilities.task_family: Maintain performance metrics, logging, health evidence, and operational troubleshooting surfaces.
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Runtime requests and startup tasks emit logs/metrics which flow into admin diagnostics and operational evidence without leaking sensitive fields.
evidence: History scan counted 172 observability-diagnostics commits; current fixed revision has performance controller, middleware, and settings packages.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Diagnostics stay with ops/release because they are usually used to explain runtime and deployment failures rather than alter business semantics.
capabilities.current_state: Covered at fixed revision with L1 routing guidance.

capabilities.task_family: Maintain GORM persistence and migrations across SQLite, MySQL, and PostgreSQL.
trigger_examples: Raw SQL must work on Postgres
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Models migrate through GORM and guarded raw SQL into SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL while cache-backed helpers preserve read/write consistency.
proof: External DSN migration tests when available
evidence: History scan counted 194 persistence-migrations commits; targeted Go test evidence passed model package.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Cross-database persistence needs a dedicated compatibility owner because raw SQL and migrations have different failure modes than business handlers.
capabilities.current_state: Covered at fixed revision with L1 routing guidance and targeted model test evidence.

capabilities.task_family: Audit a supplied web/classic commit and port missing behavior into web/default.
trigger_examples: sync this classic commit to default
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: A commit diff in web/classic is decomposed into logical behavior, mapped to web/default equivalents, triaged, ported, internationalized, and verified.
evidence: Existing repo-local skill already implements the classic/default parity workflow and now links the depth controls.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Commit-driven parity work is separate from ordinary frontend work because it starts from historical classic behavior instead of product requirements.
capabilities.current_state: Covered at fixed revision with L1 routing guidance.

capabilities.task_family: Complete and maintain default frontend translations across all supported locales.
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: English source keys are synced from `t()` calls and maintained across en, zh, fr, ru, ja, and vi flat JSON locale files.
evidence: Existing repo-local i18n skill defines sync, missing-key, and translation workflows.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: Localization work is a repeated focused loop with distinct validation commands and should not be hidden inside generic frontend guidance.
capabilities.current_state: Covered at fixed revision with L1 routing guidance.

capabilities.task_family: Route nAiApi repository requests to the correct repo-local skill and coverage proof owner.
trigger_examples: Which skill should own this change
capabilities.state_or_resource_model: Request signals are mapped to task-family skills, secondary skills, boundaries, and validation evidence before implementation begins.
evidence: Router names every delivered repo-local skill and points to machine-readable coverage/depth/eval files.
capabilities.merge_split_rationale: A router is required because nAiApi has overlapping provider relay, task, billing, security, frontend, persistence, and release surfaces.
capabilities.current_state: Covered at fixed revision with L1 route probes and audit script evidence.
